environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. AWS WAFv2 WebACL is attached to the ALB with two rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 100: AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule action override set to COUNT (not block), and CrossSiteScripting_QUERYSTRING in BLOCK mode. (2) Priority 200: A custom rule group containing a single RegexPatternSet rule that inspects the SingleQueryArgument 'value' with a regex pattern matching common SQL injection fragments including UNION, single-quote followed by OR/AND, comment sequences (--), and hex-encoded variants. The rule action is BLOCK with custom response code 403. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress except to the RDS endpoint (irrelevant here since SQLite is used), and CloudWatch Logs Insights alerting is configured on 403 responses. The WAFv2 WebACL has the default action set to ALLOW.

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate, ALB with WAFv2 WebACL attached
config.network: Private subnet, SG ingress only from ALB SG, egress restricted via VPC endpoints
config.monitoring: CloudWatch Logs Insights alert on WAF BLOCK actions
